ValidationRule.description: Require Quote Number on stages including and after Quote Development.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Quote Development"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Quote Complete"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Quote Adjustments"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ), ISBLANK( Quote_Number__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Quote Number is required before continuing to further stages.
